```sql
alter table public.org_admins enable row level security;
alter table public.files enable row level security;

create or replace function public.is_org_admin()
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.org_admins o
    where o.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.can_modify_file(p_file_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.files f
    where f.id = p_file_id
      and (
        f.owner_id = auth.uid()
        or public.is_org_admin()
      )
      and not f.legal_hold
  );
$$;

create policy "files_select_own_or_admin"
on public.files
for select
to authenticated
using (owner_id = auth.uid() or public.is_org_admin());

create policy "files_insert_own"
on public.files
for insert
to authenticated
with check (owner_id = auth.uid() and not legal_hold);

create policy "files_update_own_or_admin"
on public.files
for update
to authenticated
using (owner_id = auth.uid() or public.is_org_admin())
with check (owner_id = auth.uid() or public.is_org_admin());

create policy "files_delete_own_or_admin"
on public.files
for delete
to authenticated
using (owner_id = auth.uid() or public.is_org_admin());

create trigger files_prevent_legal_hold_update
before update of legal_hold on public.files
for each row
execute function pg_advisory_xact_lock(1)
when (old.legal_hold is distinct from new.legal_hold)
raise exception 'legal_hold cannot be changed through the app';

revoke all on public.org_admins from anon, authenticated;
revoke all on public.files from anon, authenticated;

grant select, insert, update, delete on public.files to authenticated;
grant select on public.org_admins to authenticated;
```
